runs.t: Long ago, bold men and women drove west to find gold. They left their old lives behind in hopes of being rich. These were wild times. Mines exploded with gold that could be sold for lots of cash.
Some men and women got rich, but most did not find any gold. The men and women who did not find gold went back to their old homes. There they told the tale of their time in the Wild West gold rush.
